maria (Docs): FYI I opened a docs PR for hybrid private installs that adds an mTLS-proxy chaining section, an SDK cert-rotation snippet, and a tiny network matrix. Looking for quick reviews from @devon and @olivia. Draft: https://gh.redwood/hybrid-mtls-docs-pr :memo:

devon (Network): Skimming now. One request: call out SNAT implications when chaining proxies (we lose source IP unless you preserve it in the chain). Also add the healthcheck path for the proxy.

olivia (Security): I can review the cert rotation snippet. Prefer we show an openssl example for issuing short-lived client certs and a note to rotate private keys in KMS if you use hardware-backed keys.

sam (Eng): Can we include a minimal Node SDK example that shows reloading certs (file-backed) and using an https.Agent? Pasting a short snippet below — feel free to shorten for docs style.
```javascript
// keep this tiny; production should watch file and refresh
const fs = require('fs');
const https = require('https');
function clientAgent() {
  return new https.Agent({
    cert: fs.readFileSync('/etc/redwood/client.crt'),
    key: fs.readFileSync('/etc/redwood/client.key'),
    ca: fs.readFileSync('/etc/redwood/ca.crt'),
  });
}
// use agent() per request so rotated certs are picked up
```

maria (Docs): This is great, thanks. Could you trim the comments to one line and add a short note about exponential backoff + jitter for the rotation step? We try to keep code examples ≤12 lines.

sam (Eng): Done — shortened and added a backoff comment. Pasting updated tiny snippet for the docs (2 lines of comment + 8 lines code).

devon (Network): :thumbsup: Also add a port row: "mtls-proxy 8443 -> internal 8443" and mention healthcheck path `/hc` (used by autoscaler).

olivia (Security): LGTM after a tiny wording tweak on the client cert TTL guidance (recommend 24h or less). @maria once you squash commits I'll give an approve.

maria (Docs): Will squash and push in ~20m, thanks all :sparkles:
